The '''LCK 2018 Spring''' was the first split of the 2018 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games in partnership with OnGameNet and SPOTV GAMES. The competition took place in Seoul, South Korea, from January 16 to April 14, 2018, featuring ten teams competing at LoL Park. The regular season was played in a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs followed a Single Elimination King of the Hill structure with Best-of-Five series. Teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the champion qualifying for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2018|2018 Mid-Season Invitational]]. [[bbq Olivers]] and [[Kongdoo Monster]] joined through the [[LCK/2018/Spring/Promotion|2018 Spring Promotion Tournament]]. During the offseason, [[Longzhu Gaming]] was acquired and renamed to [[KING-ZONE DragonX]], while [[Samsung Galaxy]] was purchased by [[KSV eSports]]. Matches were played on Patches 8.1 through 8.6.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2018/Summer|Summer split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2018/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Top 4 qualify for [[Rift Rivals/2018/LCK-LMS-LPL|Rift Rivals 2018 - LCK vs LMS vs LPL]]
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid Season Invitational/2018|Mid Season Invitational 2018]]
